Senior Digital Product Manager - Payments

We are a fintech company building online payment products for shops and
banks across the region. Our teams ship in small groups and own their
features from idea to launch. This role sits at the center of that work,
and you will talk to merchants, engineers and designers every week.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in digital product management
- Hands-on experience with Scrum and Agile
- Familiarity with lending and BNPL concepts is a plus

Required Tools:
- Power BI, Metabase, or Grafana

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with digital wallets and BNPL products
- Knowledge of Shaparak and payment networks
